title: Name a solid by its faces

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Faces are flat surfaces. Their shapes help us name a solid. This is a rectangular prism.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This prism has six rectangle faces in opposite pairs.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Top and bottom match.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Front and back match.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: So do left and right.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Lift it. Teal outlines the face touching the table.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seen straight on, this face has four square corners.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: It has two long sides and two short sides, so it is a rectangle, but not a square.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A triangular prism has two matching triangle ends.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: They face each other, the same distance apart.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three rectangles join them, one along each triangle edge.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: It is a triangular prism, so the bottom must be a triangle.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: That triangle is an end. This rectangle touches the table.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The face touching the table is a rectangle.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This is a square pyramid. Lift it to see its bottom.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seen straight on, the square has four equal sides and four square corners.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The square opposite the tip is its base.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One triangle is here, and another is beside it.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The third and fourth triangles are at the back.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four triangle faces meet at one tip. The base is a square.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: It has one tip, while a prism has two matching ends.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A cylinder has two equal circle faces.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Lift it to see the bottom.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The bottom is a circle, round with no corners.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This surface bends around. It is not a flat face.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Rectangular prism: six rectangles.

do.text: Name a solid by its faces

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Triangular prism: two triangles plus three rectangles.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Square pyramid: one square plus four triangles.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Cylinder: two circles plus one curved surface.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Name a solid by its faces. Its bottom face is the one touching the table.
